known_gaps.summary: Resampling is a polyphase Kaiser windowed-sinc low-pass filter (beta 5.0) that agrees with scipy, not linear interpolation. It gives about 54 dB of stopband attenuation, flat to about 13.4 kHz and stopped from about 18.6 kHz when downsampling to 32 kHz; content between 17 and 18.6 kHz is only partly attenuated, so this is not perfect anti-aliasing. Closed in this sense only: serving and offline share one pipeline.

known_gaps.summary: Reference vectors were built differently per dataset (5-window means, about 30-file means, or 10 random windows, with and without normalisation). v2 reuses the v1 reference embeddings unchanged, so site similarity still compares reef_audio windows with reference vectors built by the earlier methods.

evidence: the real-data retrain and model selection are Phase 12
known_gaps.summary: The served model is an interim 3-class MLP fitted to 100 windows from 5 sites in Indonesia and Kenya. Its leave-one-site-out balanced accuracy is 0.4375 (0.3000 to 0.5833, 4 sites); the result cannot be told apart from chance and the model is not shown to generalise to new sites.

The inference container was not rebuilt: tensorflow-cpu is unpinned (>=2.18.0) and the code downloads the 4-component handle google/surfperch/tensorFlow2/1, not the pinned google/surfperch/tensorFlow2/1/1. The SavedModel file hashes below record what was embedded against, but a rebuild could resolve different packages.
